text: Honestly, I don't really know the difference between a house and an apartment, because I come from a developing city — we don't have that distinction there.

speaker: A

text: I always just called it a house.

speaker: A

text: So I guess a house is maybe bigger than an apartment, or maybe cheaper?

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Based on that, I'd say I prefer living in a house.
